classification.difficultyReason: Use the supplied even parity to recognise that cos(-x) is the original cosine function and sketch its standard curve.

answer.worked:
Since cosine is even,
$$\begin{align*}y&=\cos(-x)\\y&=\cos x\end{align*}$$
Reflecting the cosine curve in the $y$-axis gives the same graph. Its amplitude is $1$ and its period is $2\pi$.
